_comment: Harness config. limits: spend caps (USD) the proxy enforces per workflow run and per UTC day. models: what CodeAF may use, served to it by `harness proxy` as an OpenRouter-shaped catalog; prices are USD per million tokens, from https://synthetic.new/pricing (usage-based) / GET https://api.synthetic.new/openai/v1/models, checked 2026-10-16. 'id' is what CodeAF sees; 'upstream' is the synthetic.new model id.
